11: The ordinary semantics resolver evaluates the five semantic requirement fields but not these legacy selection fields. The team receipt narrows KB/presentation selection to none and disables ambient memory. The selected-artifact path consumes **attempt** `contextArtifactIds`; it does not consume AgentDefinition `/context/artifacts` or binding `/contextGrants`. See [runtime_semantics.rs](../../../src/uar/compiler/collaboration/runtime_semantics.rs), [team policy](../../../src/uar/compiler/collaboration/team_execution/resolution.rs) and [typed context selection](../../../src/uar/compiler/collaboration/team_execution/context.rs). Baseline storage/schema acceptance is not execution support.
12: 
13: ## Shared instructions and exact member skills
14: 
15: TeamDefinition may now omit `/instructions` or provide the closed `{revision,digest,text}` object. Null, unknown fields, invalid revision, a mismatching exact UTF-8 text digest, or text exceeding 16,384 bytes refuse with the corresponding `/instructions` pointer. Existing definitions without guidance stay readable. No background migration rewrites their identities. Publish a new immutable team/package version to add or revise guidance; ordinary expected-revision binding rules still apply.
16: 
17: The compiler retains all SkillRef fields in `uar.collaboration/skill-refs` and the canonical definition extension; the preferred-ID list is only a compatibility index. Member resolution compares ID, version, digest, required flag, config, entrypoint and requiredTools against the installed private binding and captures full resolved references. Context selection preserves those exact metadata values without exposing installed filesystem locations or claiming skill-body activation. See [compatibility projection](../../../src/uar/compiler/collaboration/validation/projection.rs), [legacy artifact conversion](../../../src/uar/compiler/to_artifact.rs) and [exact installed resolution](../../../src/uar/compiler/collaboration/bindings.rs).
18: 
19: Selection receipts record the actual admitted root/approval scope, self/assignment, authorized bounded roster and selected input/artifact/message/skill metadata. A continuation includes every ordered terminal target outcome, including failed/cancelled rows with no artifacts. Revoked disclosure edges or oversized required roster/selection material refuse; no truncated guidance or partial success view is dispatched. Token count remains explicitly unknown unless independently qualified. This does not implement shared knowledge bases, implicit memory/history, or nested teams.
25: | Exact field and triggering value | Baseline behavior | Required new behavior | Planned code and operator remediation |
26: |---|---|---|---|
27: | AgentDefinition `/context/mode` = `authorized-fork` | Shape retained; team execution does not implement an authorized history fork | `required-unsupported` at this pointer; refuse executable preflight/admission | `TEAM_CONTEXT_REQUIRED_UNSUPPORTED`. Keep planning/export, or author a new immutable definition explicitly selecting the narrow profile without fork semantics, then install/rebind deliberately. Do not silently change the old value. |
28: | AgentDefinition `/context/mode` = `selected`, with a nonempty selection below | Mode is not a resolver for the authored resource references | Identify the unsupported resource pointer(s) below; no blanket denial of the word `selected` | No extra generic mode error is required. An empty selected request with `artifacts: []`, `history: none`, `memoryScopes: []` requests no additional resources and stays compatible. `none` also stays compatible. |
29: | AgentDefinition `/context/artifacts/{i}` for every nonempty authored artifact reference | Preserved; not joined to the attempt's authorized durable artifact selection | `required-unsupported` for each reference until definition-to-runtime selection is implemented | `TEAM_CONTEXT_REQUIRED_UNSUPPORTED`. For the narrow profile, explicitly revise the definition to empty this unsupported declaration and select an authorized team artifact via the existing per-admission `contextArtifactIds` control. This requires operator intent and a new immutable definition/package/binding, not an automatic rewrite. |
30: | AgentDefinition `/context/history` = `selected` | Preserved; no authored history-selection mapping in this team path | `required-unsupported`; refuse rather than union histories | `TEAM_CONTEXT_REQUIRED_UNSUPPORTED`. Use explicit task input or scoped selected artifacts in a deliberately revised definition, or retain the requirement and wait for the context-owner increment. |
31: | AgentDefinition `/context/history` = `authorized-summary` | Preserved; no grant-bound authored summary mapping in this team path | `required-unsupported`; no substitute summary inferred from ambient host history | `TEAM_CONTEXT_REQUIRED_UNSUPPORTED`. Obtain the future supported sum
